Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the VAT doc. Sorry to hear about the decline. We can proceed with the following:

- I can trigger a hosted secure card update link to the billing contact today (one-click hosted page that pushes the token to Stripe). Please confirm the billing contact you want it sent to.
- Once the customer updates the card, we will schedule an automatic retry for the next morning (we usually wait ~12 hours to allow banks to process 3DS flows).
- If you'd prefer, we can split INV-4821 into two installments (50/50) to increase authorization success — that incurs manual handling; confirm if NovaCorp wants that.

Regarding the VAT discrepancy: please confirm whether the customer is VAT-registered in the Netherlands (NL) or the UK. If they are NL-registered and supplied an NL VAT ID, we can reissue the invoice with reverse-charge wording; otherwise we'll need a corrected purchase order. If you’ve already attached the VAT registration (novacorp-vat-id.pdf) and it matches NL, we should be good to reissue.

I'm looping in Marcus from Finance Ops to add the Stripe decline metadata and confirm whether we can do a partial capture retry under the current terms.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha, Soojin — quick operational notes from Finance Ops:

- Decline code: "card_declined" with secondary code "insufficient_funds" returned by Stripe. Acquirer: ING Netherlands.
- We're attaching a short decline report for your accounting team to share with the payer (stripe-decline-report.txt).
- Recommended next steps (in order):
  1) Send hosted update link (PCI-compliant) so the cardholder can re-enter payment credentials and complete 3DS (preferred).
  2) If the cardholder cannot complete 3DS, try a manual retry with SCA fallback tomorrow morning (we can set window 08:00–10:00 CET for retries).
  3) If retries fail, split invoice into two smaller charges to increase auth success — we will only do this with explicit confirmation from NovaCorp.

- Regarding VAT: if NovaCorp confirms NL VAT registration (and the document attached is valid), we can reissue the invoice with reverse-charge language and no VAT charged. That will not affect the total amount due; it only changes the tax treatment on the invoice for reconciliation.

I'll prepare the decline report and set up the retry schedule once Soojin confirms the contact for the update link.

Cheers,
